enrollment_started: Enrollment started. Add the student's courses next.
search_placeholder: Name, student no. or enrollment no.
name: Name
admitted_awaiting: admitted applicants are waiting to be enrolled.
new_students_help: Admitted and conditionally admitted applicants who are not enrolled yet, including TCLASS trainees.
continuing_students_help: Students who already have a record from an earlier enrollment.
no_term_open: No term is open for enrollment. Open a term first in
term_not_open: This term is not open for enrollment.
application_not_admitted: Only admitted or conditionally admitted CHED applicants can be enrolled.
student_required: Choose a student or an admitted application.
already_has_enrollment_for_term: This student already has an enrollment record for this term.
curriculum_not_for_program: Choose an active curriculum of the same program.
load_empty_help: No courses yet. Load a block or add courses below.
load_block_help: Adds every course of the section that passes all checks. Anything with an issue is listed so you can decide one by one.
block_has_no_offerings: That section has no offerings this term.
skipped_from_block: Not added from the block. Review these individually:
needs_override: Needs an exception from an authorized adviser
no_matching_offerings: No open offerings match. Check the filters or set up offerings in
override_reason_needed: Give a reason to add it as an exception.
override_permission_needed: You are not allowed to approve exceptions.
load_locked: The study load can only change while the enrollment is in advising.
load_is_empty: Add at least one course first.
overload_needs_reason: The load is above the program's maximum units. An authorized adviser must give a reason
over_max_units: The load is above the program's maximum units.
next_advising: Build the study load, then send it to Accounting for assessment.
next_for_assessment: Waiting for Accounting to generate the assessment.
next_assessed: Accounting applies a scholarship or records an official receipt, then issues clearance. The registrar validates only after the student is cleared.
next_enrolled: Officially enrolled. Print the Certificate of Registration for the student.
next_enrolled_trainee: Officially enrolled. Print the trainee registration for the learner.
final_withdrawn: The student officially withdrew this term.
cannot_return_to_advising: Only enrollments that are not yet validated can go back to advising.
enrollment_validated: Enrollment validated. The student is officially enrolled.
confirm_validate: Validate this enrollment? The student will be officially enrolled.
not_ready_for_validation: Issue clearance before the registrar validates.
confirm_status_change: Apply this change? It is recorded in the history.
only_enrolled_can_reopen: Only enrolled records can be reopened.
cannot_cancel: Validated enrollments cannot be cancelled. Use withdraw instead.
not_ready_for_assessment: Send the load for assessment first.
apply_ra_10931_help: Waives the fees marked as covered in the fee schedule. Apply only after confirming the student is eligible.
no_fee_lines: No fees apply. Set up the fee schedule before assessing if fees should be charged.
results_help: Passed courses count toward prerequisites in later terms.
results_only_when_enrolled: Results can only be recorded for enrolled students.
cor_ra_10931_note: Tuition and covered fees are subsidized under Republic Act No. 10931 (Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act).
choose_curriculum_to_evaluate: Choose a curriculum to evaluate the student's progress.
credited_courses_help: Courses accepted from a previous school. They count as passed for prerequisites.
offering_exists: This course already has an offering with that section code this term.
offering_has_students: Students are enlisted in this offering. Close or dissolve it instead.
no_offerings: No offerings for this term yet.
no_faculty_yet: No staff records yet. Faculty can be assigned once staff are added.
schedule_help: One row per meeting. Leave the day blank to skip a row. Room and faculty double-bookings are blocked.
end_after_start: The end time must be after the start time.
room_double_booked: Room is already booked at that time
faculty_double_booked: Faculty already teaches at that time
generate_section: Generate a block section from a curriculum
generate_help: Creates one offering for every curriculum course of the chosen year level in this term's semester, all under one section code. Add schedules, rooms and faculty afterward.
generate_needs_curriculum: Generating needs an active curriculum. Set one up in
add_schedules_next: Add schedules, rooms and faculty next.
no_curriculum_courses_for_term: That curriculum has no courses for this year level and semester.
curriculum_authority_hint: CMO, board resolution or approval reference
curriculum_status_help: Only active curricula can be assigned to students. Keep a curriculum in draft while encoding it; retire it when no new students should use it.
curriculum_draft_notice: This curriculum is a draft. Set it to active when it is complete so students can be enrolled under it.
no_curricula: No curricula yet. Add one per program, then encode its courses.
curriculum_empty: No courses yet. Add courses by year level and semester.
choose_or_create_below: Choose, or create a new course below
confirm_remove_course: Remove this course from the curriculum? Requisites that point to it are removed too.
units_change_help: Changing units affects new enlistments only. Loads already enlisted keep the units they were enlisted with.
fee_schedule_help: Fees are applied when Accounting generates an assessment. No amounts are preset: enter only fees approved by the college. Mark a fee as covered by RA 10931 if it is waived for eligible students.
confirm_delete_fee: Delete this fee? Existing assessments keep their amounts.
format_help: Use {YYYY} for the starting year of the academic year and {SEQ} for the running number. Letters, digits, dashes, slashes and dots are allowed.
format_rules: The format must contain {SEQ} and use only letters, digits, dashes, slashes, dots and the placeholders.
student_number_confirm: The default format is a placeholder. Confirm the official student number format with the Registrar before the first validation.
terms_open_help: Advisers can only start enrollments in the terms checked here.
max_units_help: Loads above this need an authorized adviser's reason. Leave blank for no limit.
next_cleared: The account is cleared. The registrar can validate the enrollment. A student number is assigned on validation.
scholarship_name: Name, if it is not one of the programs above
scholarship_other_help: Choose Other and type the name when the award is not TES, TWSP, STEP, or UAQTEA. The amount cannot be more than the balance.
confirm_clear: Issue clearance? The registrar can validate after this.
receipts_carry_forward: Scholarships and official receipts already recorded will apply again when this enrollment is assessed.
clearance_issued: Clearance issued. The registrar can now validate.
clearance_lapsed: Clearance was revoked because a balance is due again.
clearance_locked: Scholarships and receipts can be recorded only while the enrollment is for clearance or cleared.
not_ready_for_clearance: Generate the assessment before issuing clearance.
balance_still_due: A balance is still due. Clearance needs the balance at zero.
nothing_due: Nothing is due. Issue clearance instead of recording another amount.
amount_exceeds_balance: The amount is more than the balance still due.
or_already_used: That official receipt number is already recorded.
or_date_future: The official receipt date cannot be in the future.
outcome_ra_10931: Cleared under RA 10931. No amount is due from the student.
outcome_scholarship: Cleared by scholarship. No cash collection was required.
outcome_scholarship_and_payment: Cleared by a scholarship and an official receipt.
outcome_fully_paid: Cleared. The amount due was paid in full.
outcome_no_amount_due: Cleared. The assessment has no amount due.
schedule_hint: Days and time, as the college runs this batch
batch_has_trainees: This batch already has trainees, so it cannot be removed.
batch_full: That batch has no open slots.
already_in_batch: This trainee is already in that batch.
already_has_open_training: This trainee already has an open training record.
batch_program_mismatch: The batch does not belong to this qualification.
batch_program_locked: The qualification cannot change after a trainee is placed in the batch.
slots_below_taken: Slots cannot be fewer than the trainees already placed.
training_hours_help: Nominal duration of a TESDA qualification. Leave this blank for a college program, and until the college records the hours.
entry_requirements_help: What a trainee must meet before placement in a batch. Leave this blank for a college program.
entry_requirements_blank: Entry requirements have not been written on this qualification yet.
eligibility_not_met: Does not meet the entry requirements
eligibility_required: Record that the trainee meets the entry requirements before assessment.
eligibility_remarks_required: Say why the trainee does not meet the entry requirements.
eligibility_remarks_hint: What was checked, and anything still missing
uli_help: Enter the ULI only when TESDA has issued one. This record does not create a ULI.
next_tesda_advising: Check the entry requirements, then send the trainee for assessment. Accounting clears the record before the registrar validates it.
no_open_batch: There is no open training batch for this qualification.
no_tesda_program: Add a TESDA qualification under Admission setup before opening a batch.
assessment_uses_fees: Assessment uses fee rows for this qualification that are not tied to a semester.
bsrs_outside: Encoding in BSRS and T2MIS stays outside this system.
registration_note: This is the college copy of the trainee registration. Scholarship encoding in BSRS or T2MIS is done outside this record.
not_a_course_enrollment: A training batch does not use a course load.
learner_locked: The learner profile can no longer be changed.
trainee_type_required: Choose new trainee or returning trainee.
fee_term_help: Leave the term blank for a training batch. A semester applies only to college enrollment.
password_shown_once: Write this down. It is shown only this once and is not sent by email.
portal_needs_email: The student number was issued. Add an email below to open the portal sign-in.
email_taken: That email or student number is already used for a sign-in.
portal_opened_short: The portal sign-in is open. The temporary password is shown above.
portal_already_open: This student already has a portal sign-in.
guardian_opened_short: The guardian sign-in is open. The temporary password is shown above.
guardian_already_open: This student already has a guardian sign-in.
report_note: Working list for the college. This is not a CHED or TESDA form.
portal_no_record: No student record is linked to this sign-in.
portal_no_enrollment: No enrollment is on file yet.
staff_not_linked: This sign-in is not linked to a staff record, so no classes can be listed.
no_enrolled_students: No enrolled student is on this list yet.
grade_help: Use 1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, 2.25, 2.50, 2.75, 3.00, 4.00, 5.00, or INC. 1.00 is the highest. A 4.00 needs a removal date. INC needs a passing class standing.
not_your_class: That student is not on this class list.
competency_help: Record whether the trainee is competent. Competency units stay with TESDA.
special_semester_cap: A special student may take at most 6 units in a semester.
special_year_cap: A special student may take at most 12 units in one academic year.
special_one_year: A special student may enroll in only one academic year.
midyear_cap: The midyear term is limited to 9 units.
graduating_cap: A graduating overload cannot exceed 28 units.
probation_no_overload: A student on probation cannot take a load above the program maximum.
only_graduating_may_overload: Only a graduating student may take a load above the program maximum.
midterm_date_required: Set the midterm examination date on the term before dropping a course from an official registration.
unofficial_drop: Dropped after the midterm. Recorded as 5.00.
unofficial_drop_saved: The course stays on the record as 5.00 because the midterm date has passed.
inc_needs_passing_standing: INC is allowed only when class standing is already passing. Otherwise post 5.00.
removal_date_required: A grade of 4.00 needs the removal date set by the office.
absence_warning: At least one student has absences of 20% or more of the class meetings. Confirm the drop on that row.
absence_not_reached: Absences are still below 20% of the scheduled meetings.
absence_drop_saved: The course was dropped for absences.
inc_overdue: INC is still open more than one year after the term ended.
rsa_help: Each academic year enrolled is half a year of return service. Four academic years are two years of service. The student and a parent or guardian sign first. The President of the College signs after that. The agreement takes effect upon graduation.
rsa_counts_when_validated: This academic year is counted when the registrar validates the enrollment.
rsa_required: Record the return service agreement before enrollment. The student and a parent or guardian sign first, then the President of the College.
rsa_guardian_name: Name of the parent or guardian who signed
rsa_record_guardian: Record the parent or guardian's signature
rsa_sign_first: The student and a parent or guardian sign before the agreement is endorsed to the President.
rsa_waiver_authority: Cite the approved policy, resolution, or authority
rsa_waived: An official waiver is on file. The agreement does not apply.
log_rsa_student: Student signed the return service agreement
log_rsa_guardian: Parent or guardian signed the return service agreement
log_rsa_president: President signed the return service agreement
retention_warning_load: A student on warning takes three units below the normal load
retention_probation_load: A student on probation may take at most 15 units, and not above the program maximum
retention_dismissed: A dismissed student may not enroll
retention_disqualified: A permanently disqualified student may not enroll
retention_may_lift: Probation may be lifted because every course in that term was passed.
academic_scholarship_help: One grant for this semester. It may be renewed next semester when the conditions are met again. A student who qualifies for more than one grant takes only one. This is separate from a TES, TWSP, STEP, or UAQTEA clearance.
academic_scholarship_one: This semester already has one academic scholarship.
academic_scholarship_college: An academic scholarship is recorded on a college enrollment.
academic_scholarship_sponsor: Name the agency, organization, or benefactor
academic_scholarship_sponsor_required: Name the agency, organization, or benefactor.
academic_scholarship_discipline: The discipline record must be clear.
academic_scholarship_discipline_label: The student is of good moral character and has no disciplinary action on record.
academic_scholarship_not_qualified: The previous semester does not meet the scholarship conditions.
academic_scholarship_reason_no_previous: There is no completed college semester before this enrollment.
academic_scholarship_reason_units: The previous semester must be 15 or 18 units.
academic_scholarship_reason_grade: The previous semester has a 4.00, an INC, or a 5.00.
academic_scholarship_reason_unfinished: The previous semester still has a course without a final grade.
academic_scholarship_reason_gwa: The previous semester average must be 2.50 or better.
academic_program_pgt_tes: Provincial Government of Tarlac scholarship and Tertiary Education Subsidy
